description:
CitePulse: Academic citation analytics for AI research agents, grant offices, and PIs — bibliography verification, retraction detection, paper/author/institution/journal metrics, topic and funder impact scans, and grounded literature briefs. Built on open scholarly infrastructure (OpenAlex, Crossref). All endpoints require x402 payment (USDC on Base mainnet) via the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.

Coverage: Global

Endpoints:
  • ref-check ($0.02): Bibliography verification (flagship)
  • paper ($0.02): Single-paper lookup
  • author ($0.02): Author metrics
  • institution ($0.02): Institution research-output benchmark
  • journal ($0.10): Journal/venue intelligence
  • topic-scan ($0.20): Rising-topic research scan
  • funder-impact ($0.20): Funder research-impact brief
  • literature-brief ($0.25): Grounded literature synthesis

action.description: Which endpoint to call. Options: ref-check | paper | author | institution | journal | topic-scan | funder-impact | literature-brief

citations.description: Comma-separated list of DOIs and/or free-text references, up to 20 items.

compare_to.description: Optional second institution name for a side-by-side benchmark

openalex_id.description: OpenAlex author ID for an exact, disambiguated lookup

title.description: Paper title (used only if doi is omitted)

name: citepulse
